references.text: Describes the same event where many Jews came to Mary and Martha to comfort them after Lazarus had died, which led to them seeing Lazarus raised from the dead and believing in Jesus.
Refers to the same feast and stay in Bethany just before Passover, where Lazarus was present and plans were made to kill him.
Provides background information about Martha who served and Lazarus whom Jesus loved, who are central figures in the verse.
